Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present, with the value "true", only when the response is the stored answer replayed for the same Idempotency-Key, method, path and body. The first execution never carries it.

regionId.description: The destination region; absent means every region.

localTime.description: Order deadline HH:mm in the destination delivery station's time zone.

400.description: The Idempotency-Key header is missing (idempotency-key-required) or malformed (idempotency-key-invalid), the request body is malformed, or a collection GET sent an undeclared query parameter (unknown-query-parameter), a bad limit (invalid-limit) or an undecodable cursor (invalid-cursor).

detail.example: Book AUS3:dep-pickup-0418 has no room left (share 2500).

value.title: Idempotency-Key header is required
value.detail: send an Idempotency-Key header with a unique value per logical request

409.description: State, capacity, closed or concurrency conflict (illegal-transition, concurrent-update, offer-not-quotable, promise-capacity-exhausted, book-closed, promise-hold-expired, promise-closed, revision-moves-earlier), or idempotency-key-reused when the Idempotency-Key was already used with a different method, path or body.

detail.example: Book AUS3:dep-pickup-0418 has no room left (share 2500).

value.title: Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request
value.detail: the Idempotency-Key was already used with a different method, path or body

detail.example: Book AUS3:dep-pickup-0418 has no room left (share 2500).
